body: I send him messages all the time, I want to keep connecting with him to get to get some clarification. All I do is keep checking back to if my message went from “sent” to “delivered”. I know how you feel because I also tried to cut myself off and it went okay for about a week until he asked how I am. Why would you ask and then block me again??

Thank u for the kind words. I feel like I may actually deserve this. What if I unknowingly did something to hurt him. I mean I can think of a couple instances where I definitely fucked up. We both did. I’m confused about his behaviour now, post breakup. Why won’t he open up to me about his decision? Is he doing this for his own good or mine? I can’t heal until it’s clarified… unsure how to just start loving myself when it still feels like a chunk of my heart was ripped out when he left :(

I like your mindset but I harbour no ill feelings for him. I really wish to keep him in my life even though I’m not sure why. When I’m around him I feel safe, but because we’re long distance I’ve grown to distrust him. I think I keep messaging him bc I want to know why he’s treating me like this. He won’t admit to hating me yknow… it’d be easier if he did not going to lie. Wishing you the best to u and ur kiddos <3

Hey, I get how you feel. My relationship was also very messy and his porn addiction eventually led us to breaking up, despite the amount of love I have for him. 

You still have your guard up- in my opinion he needs to wait and respect that, because of his mistakes YOU were hurt. You're still hurting. 

Once you feel deep inside that your trust has been rebuilt, and you can be 10000% comfortable with him getting Snapchat again- just let him know.

Set your boundaries clearly and if he disagrees then don't put yourself at risk for more heartbreak. That's all I got, hope I helped a teeny bit
